_comment: The gateway mapping that puts `occupation-lookup` on a URL the browser can POST to.
This is not a flow definition -- build-flows.mjs loads flows by explicit name, so this
file is inert to it. It is the reproducible record of the three API calls that made the
route, because there is no other place in this repo that records a mapping.
The mapping lives on the ACCOUNT's own gateway, not on api.microstrate.io. A tenant
cannot write to the platform gateway, so a tenant flow is always served from
`<gateway-id>.microstrate.io`. Find the id with `GET /gateway/all`; on the
antipodean_build staging account (9227248058) it is VWqPwSvI9DMS, so the browser POSTs
Three calls, in order. All three are required -- see `traps` below.

mapping_version.description: Occupation type-ahead for the quote form

traps: POST /gateway/{id}/mapping does NOT set traffic_distribution, and cerberus skips every version whose weight is 0 (`if mapping.TrafficDistribution[v.Version] == 0 { continue }`, gateway_api.go). The route then mounts with an empty version list, PickRandomItem returns nothing, and the request dies in the recoverer as a 500 with an EMPTY BODY. The PATCH in step 3 is what makes the route work at all.

The mapping can be in the data plane and not in effect. Both writes above land on the gateway stream, but the route stayed a plain-text `404 page not found` for over five minutes. `bcli publish ms.gateway.<id>.reload` is the documented fix and bcli cannot reach a sub-account. What worked over HTTP: `PATCH /gateway/{gateway_id}` with any harmless field (a description) -- that writes ms.gateway.<id>.gateway, which cerberus's stream consumer turns into a per-gateway config rebuild. The route served on the next request.

A mapping version with no authorization middleware gets DenyClientAuthorizer by default, so a `client`-role session is refused. Brokers onboarded as `client` need an explicit authorization middleware on the version before they can use this route.
invocation_type must be RequestResponse or the gateway does not await the run and the browser gets nothing to read.
